title: Enterprise 10.6.2 HTTP client issue rows lack exact package mapping
problem: The Enterprise 10.6.2 Known Issues and Fixed Issues both name parent SPL-318243 in Uncategorized issues dated November 26. The fixed row is SPL-322704; the known list has distinct SPL-322695 through SPL-322703 rows with the same OAuth2/TLS HTTP client description. These are new itemized observations under the Enterprise release headings. The article text supplies no mapping of those tickets to the exact 10.6.2.5 package, operating systems, configurations or a CVE.

exclusions: No unlisted exact package applicability, deployment, entitlement or customer authorization is established.

scopeComparison: The known and fixed articles share the parent issue ID, with distinct itemized tickets. Neither exact OS nor four-segment applicability can be assigned from their labels.

impact.customerScenario: Selecting an exact customer-managed Enterprise package for an OAuth2/TLS issue.
impact.consequence: The published release tables cannot establish which specific package contains the fix.

confidence.rationale: Exact release headings and itemized rows were independently read; product impact and detailed applicability remain unverified.
